items.zh: 中国的高铁技术已达到世界领先水平，并出口到多个国家。
items.reference: China's high-speed rail technology has reached the world's leading level and has been exported to many countries.
hints: 得分点：高铁技术 / 达到 / 领先水平 / 出口到
「高铁」是 high-speed rail；「领先水平」可用 the leading level；「出口」用被动 be exported to
句型：China's high-speed rail technology has reached … and has been exported to …

items.zh: 中国在5G通信领域取得了重大突破，走在了世界前列。
items.reference: China has made major breakthroughs in the field of 5G communications and is at the forefront of the world.
hints: 得分点：重大突破 / 在……领域 / 通信 / 走在……前列
「取得突破」用 make breakthroughs；「前列」可用 the forefront；「5G通信」可写 5G communications
句型：China has made major breakthroughs in the field of … and is at the forefront of …

items.zh: 中国的航天事业稳步推进，载人航天和探月工程成果丰硕。
items.reference: China's space program has been advancing steadily, with fruitful results in manned spaceflight and lunar exploration.
hints: 得分点：航天事业 / 稳步推进 / 载人航天 / 探月工程
「载人的」用 manned；「探月」可译为 lunar exploration；「成果丰硕」用 fruitful results
句型：China's space program has been advancing steadily, with fruitful results in … and …

items.zh: 人工智能正被广泛应用于医疗、教育和交通等领域。
items.reference: These days, artificial intelligence is being widely applied in fields such as medical care, education and transportation.
hints: 得分点：人工智能 / 广泛应用 / 在……等领域 / 医疗
「人工智能」是 artificial intelligence；「应用」用 apply，此处用现在进行时的被动语态
句型：These days, artificial intelligence is being widely applied in fields such as …, … and …

items.zh: 中国自主研发的卫星导航系统已为全球用户提供高精度定位服务。
items.reference: The satellite navigation system independently developed by China has provided high-precision positioning services for users around the world.
hints: 得分点：自主研发 / 卫星导航系统 / 定位服务 / 全球用户
「自主研发」可用 independently developed by，作后置定语；「为……提供……」用 provide sth. for sb.
句型：The satellite navigation system independently developed by China has provided … for …

items.zh: 量子计算被认为是下一代信息技术的关键，中国科学家正加紧研究。
items.reference: Chinese scientists are stepping up their research on quantum computing, which is considered the key to the next generation of information technology.
hints: 得分点：量子计算 / 被认为 / 下一代…… / 加紧
「被认为是」用 be considered (as)；「加紧」可用 step up；「……的关键」用 the key to
句型：Chinese scientists are stepping up their research on …, which is considered the key to …

items.zh: 中国的超级计算机多次位居世界前列，运算速度不断提升。
items.reference: Chinese supercomputers have repeatedly ranked among the top in the world, and their computing speed keeps increasing.
hints: 得分点：超级计算机 / 位居前列 / 世界 / 运算速度
「位居前列」可用 rank among the top；「运算速度」是 computing speed；「不断」用 keep doing
句型：Chinese supercomputers have repeatedly ranked among the top …, and their computing speed keeps increasing.

items.zh: 新能源汽车在中国的销量持续增长，充电桩等配套设施日益完善。
items.reference: The sales of new energy vehicles in China keep growing, and supporting facilities such as charging piles are becoming more and more complete.
hints: 得分点：新能源汽车 / 持续增长 / 配套设施 / 充电桩
「新能源汽车」是 new energy vehicles；「持续」用 keep doing；「充电桩」可译 charging pile
句型：The sales of … keep growing, and supporting facilities such as … are becoming more and more complete.

items.zh: 中国的桥梁建设技术世界闻名，许多大桥创造了世界纪录。
items.reference: China's bridge construction technology is world-famous, and many bridges have set world records.
hints: 得分点：桥梁建设技术 / 世界闻名 / 世界纪录 / 许多大桥
「世界闻名」可用 world-famous；「创造纪录」用 set a record
句型：China's bridge construction technology is world-famous, and many bridges have set world records.

items.zh: 随着大数据技术的发展，城市管理变得更加高效和智能。
items.reference: Thanks to the development of big data technology, urban management has become more efficient and smarter.
hints: 得分点：……的发展 / 大数据技术 / 城市管理 / 更加高效
「大数据」是 big data；「城市的」用 urban；「高效」是 efficient，用比较级；「随着」可用 thanks to
句型：Thanks to the development of …, urban management has become more efficient and smarter.

items.zh: 中国科学家在干细胞研究领域取得了令世界瞩目的成果。
items.reference: Chinese scientists have achieved results that have attracted worldwide attention in the field of stem cell research.
hints: 得分点：取得成果 / 令世界瞩目 / 在……领域 / 干细胞研究
「令世界瞩目」用 attract worldwide attention，可用 that 引导定语从句修饰 results
句型：Chinese scientists have achieved results that have attracted worldwide attention in the field of …

items.zh: 无人机被广泛用于农业喷洒、航拍和快递配送等领域。
items.reference: Drones are widely used in areas such as agricultural spraying, aerial photography and express delivery.
hints: 得分点：广泛用于 / 农业喷洒 / 航拍 / 快递配送
「无人机」是 drone；「航拍」可用 aerial photography；「快递」可译 express delivery
句型：Drones are widely used in areas such as …, … and …

items.zh: 中国的深海探测器多次下潜至万米海底，刷新了下潜纪录。
items.reference: China's deep-sea submersibles have dived to a depth of ten thousand meters several times, setting new diving records.
hints: 得分点：深海探测器 / 下潜至……的深度 / 万米 / 刷新下潜纪录
「探测器」可用 submersible；「深度」用 depth；「刷新纪录」用 set a new record，此处用现在分词作结果状语
句型：China's deep-sea submersibles have dived to a depth of … several times, setting new diving records.

items.zh: 中国的移动支付技术领先世界，大大方便了人们的日常生活。
items.reference: China's mobile payment technology leads the world and has greatly facilitated people's daily lives.
hints: 得分点：移动支付技术 / 领先世界 / 方便 / 日常生活
「领先世界」可用 lead the world；「方便」作动词时可用 facilitate
句型：China's mobile payment technology leads the world and has greatly facilitated …

items.zh: 中国的大型客机成功完成首飞，标志着航空工业的重大进步。
items.reference: The successful maiden flight of China's large passenger aircraft marked major progress in its aviation industry.
hints: 得分点：首飞 / 大型客机 / 标志着重大进步 / 航空工业
「首飞」是 maiden flight；「客机」可用 passenger aircraft；「标志着」用 mark
句型：The successful maiden flight of … marked major progress in its aviation industry.

items.zh: 中国的可再生能源装机容量持续增长，清洁能源占比不断提高。
items.reference: China's installed capacity of renewable energy keeps growing, and the share of clean energy continues to rise.
hints: 得分点：装机容量 / 可再生能源 / 持续增长 / 清洁能源
「可再生的」是 renewable；「装机容量」可译 installed capacity；「占比」用 the share of
句型：China's installed capacity of … keeps growing, and the share of clean energy continues to rise.

items.zh: 中国的科技企业加大研发投入，专利申请量逐年攀升。
items.reference: Chinese technology companies have increased their investment in research and development, and the number of patent applications has been rising year by year.
hints: 得分点：加大……的投入 / 研发 / 专利申请 / 逐年
「研发」固定说法是 research and development（R&D）；「专利」是 patent；「申请」是 application
句型：Chinese technology companies have increased their investment in …, and the number of … has been rising year by year.

items.zh: 远程医疗让偏远地区的患者也能享受到优质的医疗资源。
items.reference: With telemedicine, patients in remote areas can also enjoy high-quality medical resources.
hints: 得分点：远程医疗 / 偏远地区 / 享受 / 优质的医疗资源
「远程医疗」是 telemedicine；「偏远地区」可用 remote areas；「让……能够……」可用 enable sb. to do，也可用 with … 引出
句型：With telemedicine, patients in remote areas can also enjoy …

items.zh: 中国的空间站建设进展顺利，为科学实验提供了重要平台。
items.reference: The construction of China's space station is progressing smoothly, providing an important platform for scientific experiments.
hints: 得分点：空间站 / 进展顺利 / 重要的平台 / 科学实验
「进展顺利」可用 progress smoothly；「为……提供……」用 provide sth. for sth.，此处用现在分词作伴随状语
句型：The construction of … is progressing smoothly, providing an important platform for …

items.zh: 随着科技的进步，中国人的生活方式发生了翻天覆地的变化。
items.reference: Thanks to the progress of science and technology, the lifestyle of Chinese people has undergone earth-shaking changes.
hints: 得分点：……的进步 / 科技 / 生活方式 / 翻天覆地的变化
「发生（变化）」可用 undergo；「翻天覆地的」可用 earth-shaking／tremendous；「随着」可用 thanks to
句型：Thanks to the progress of …, the lifestyle of Chinese people has undergone earth-shaking changes.
